item.title: Precision Strategies Acquires Firehouse Strategies To Create Public Affairs Firm With 125 Professionals
item.description: Precision Strategies announced it has acquired Firehouse Strategies, combining two Washington, D.C.-based public affairs firms founded by veterans of presidential campaigns. The deal brings together firms that previously operated on opposite sides of major political campaigns, expanding Precision’s capabilities in strategic communications, digital engagement, and grassroots influence.
